[3:18PM] #AlausaIkeja #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic movement along Obafemi Awolowo Way is steady from Coca-Cola Junction to Radio. From Radio to Allen Junction, movement is slow but steady, while traffic from Allen Junction toward Balogun remains busy through to underneath the bridge due to turning activities at Olowu and the effect of alternating traffic signals.

 The return journey on this stretch experiences a similar situation. Along Lateef Jakande, movement is good to go from Coca-Cola through Cadbury, First Gate, Wemco Road, Wemco Junction, and onward to Omole Roundabout. Vehicular flow on Aromire inward Adeniyi Jones is smooth, with only brief alternations where necessary. 

The entire Mobolaji Johnson Avenue is also clear, with free movement from Old Tollgate through 7Up Gate, Billingsway, and down to Alausa Intersection. The stretch of Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo connecting to Otedola Under Bridge is equally free-flowing. Governors Road, Governors Avenue, Ashabi Cole, and Hakeem Balogun remain calm at this time. 

No impediments have been reported, and traffic management structures are in place in case of any unexpected developments.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:37PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon  #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is slow and steady when descending from CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal Market due to market activities and vehicular movements in and out of the market. However, immediately after Offin Canal Market, the stretch toward Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection is free-flowing. 

Movement along Broad Street through Apongbon underneath the bridge, connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, is steady. The Eko Bridge inward Apongbon to link CMS Bridge, Elegbeta, and CFAO is also in good shape. Descending Idumota Bridge inward Ebute-Ero Market, through Leventis and the UBA Roundabout to connect both Inner and Outer Marina, is moving well.

 At the moment, there are no impediments, and our personnel are on ground effectively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
